# Goji Women's and Family Physiotherapy

> Goji Physiotherapy (also known as Goji Physio) is a women's and family
> physiotherapy clinic at Lentor Modern, Singapore (1 minute from Lentor MRT,
> Thomson-East Coast Line, Exit 1). We provide prenatal, postnatal,
> pelvic-health, paediatric, and musculoskeletal physiotherapy, a continuum of
> care for women and their families in one clinic. AHPC-registered
> physiotherapists. Home visits available across Singapore, including the East
> Coast.

## About

- Name: Goji Women's and Family Physiotherapy (short forms: Goji Physiotherapy, Goji Physio)
- Website: https://www.gojiphysio.com/
- Location: 1 Lentor Central, #01-13, Lentor Modern, Singapore 788887 (above Lentor MRT station; serves Lentor, Ang Mo Kio, Yio Chu Kang, Upper Thomson, Springleaf and Bishan, with home visits island-wide)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 8am to 8pm; Sunday & public holidays by appointment only
- Phone: +65 8377 0401

## Before you book

Full answers: https://www.gojiphysio.com/services/#faq

- First appointment: a conversation about your history, concerns and goals, a physical assessment, an explanation of what was found, and a plan. A first physiotherapy session is 55 minutes; the Mummy & Baby assessment is 85 minutes.
- Cost: a 55-minute physiotherapy session is $260 in-clinic or $380 as a home visit; the Mummy & Baby assessment is $330 in-clinic or $450 as a home visit. No direct billing: most patients pay first and claim from their insurer.
- Men: yes, we treat men as well as women and children, including sports injuries, back and neck pain, joint and muscle problems, post-surgery rehabilitation and return to sport. Our physiotherapists are trained in sports and orthopaedic rehabilitation (the team includes a Master of Exercise Science); clinical Pilates and strength and conditioning are open to men too. Sports rehabilitation: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/sports-rehabilitation/
- Referral: private physiotherapy in Singapore can be booked directly, without a doctor's referral. No referral is needed for our women's health appointments. Some insurers require a doctor's referral letter to reimburse physiotherapy.

## Services

- Women's health physiotherapy (pelvic floor, prenatal, postnatal)
- Paediatric physiotherapy (infancy to 18)
- Musculoskeletal & sports physiotherapy
- Strength & conditioning (physiotherapist-led exercise)
- Clinical Pilates (AHPC-registered physiotherapist-led exercise)
- Private Pilates (STOTT PILATES® certified instructor-led exercise)
- Vestibular rehabilitation
- Lymphoedema physiotherapy

## Conditions we treat

All conditions: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/

### Women's health

- Prenatal care and birth preparation: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/prenatal-care/
- Pelvic girdle pain: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/pelvic-girdle-pain/
- Diastasis recti: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/diastasis-recti/
- Caesarean recovery and scar management: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/caesarean-recovery/
- Perineal tear and birth trauma: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/perineal-tear/
- Blocked ducts and mastitis: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/blocked-ducts-mastitis/
- Pelvic organ prolapse: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/pelvic-organ-prolapse/
- Pelvic pain and dyspareunia: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/pelvic-pain/
- Urinary incontinence: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/urinary-incontinence/
- Bowel dysfunction: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/bowel-dysfunction/
- Menopause, osteopenia & osteoporosis: https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/menopause/

### Paediatrics

- Adolescent scoliosis and Schroth therapy (a scoliosis-specific exercise approach for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, used alongside monitoring and bracing): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/adolescent-scoliosis-schroth/
- Clubfoot (CTEV) (physiotherapy for postural CTEV, and support alongside the Ponseti pathway for structural CTEV): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/clubfoot-ctev/
- Congenital torticollis (for babies whose head tilts to one side or who cannot turn their neck fully): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/congenital-torticollis/
- Developmental concerns and early intervention (for children not meeting expected gross motor milestones): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/developmental-concerns/
- Hip dysplasia (DDH) (physiotherapy before, during and after harness or surgical treatment): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/hip-dysplasia-ddh/
- Neurodevelopmental conditions (physical function and independence for children with cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, autism and related conditions): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/neurodevelopmental-conditions/
- Paediatric pelvic health (bedwetting, daytime wetting, soiling and constipation in children): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/paediatric-pelvic-health/
- Paediatric sports injuries (assessment and rehabilitation for children and adolescents, with growing bones in mind): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/paediatric-sports-injuries/
- Post-fracture rehabilitation (range of motion, strength and confidence after cast removal or surgery): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/post-fracture-rehab/

### Musculoskeletal & sports

- Musculoskeletal pain and injuries (back, neck, shoulder, knee and other joint pain, sprains, strains and overuse injuries): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/musculoskeletal-pain-and-injuries/
- Persistent and recurrent pain (including arthritis-related joint pain): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/persistent-pain/
- Adult scoliosis (Schroth-based exercise and pain management, with Cheryl Long): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/adult-scoliosis/
- Sports rehabilitation and performance (staged return to sport and injury-risk work): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/sports-rehabilitation/
- Post-operative recovery and rehabilitation (joint replacement, ligament repair, spinal and orthopaedic surgery): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/post-surgery-rehabilitation/
- Functional movement assessment (how you squat, hinge, reach and balance, with a prioritised exercise plan): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/functional-movement-assessment/
- Dry needling (only available in sessions with Cheryl Long): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/dry-needling/

### Vestibular rehabilitation

- Vertigo (room-spinning sensations, assessed for cause): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/vertigo/
- Dizziness (lightheadedness, swaying and ongoing unsteadiness): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/dizziness/
- Balance difficulties (unsteadiness, near-falls and loss of confidence on your feet): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/balance-problems/
- Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo, BPPV (positional tests and repositioning manoeuvres): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/bppv/
- Fall prevention and age-related instability (strength and balance programmes): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/fall-prevention/

### Lymphatic health

- Lymphoedema (manual lymphatic drainage, compression, exercise and skin care): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/lymphoedema/
- Swelling management (persistent or post-surgical swelling, matched to the cause): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/swelling-management/
- Lipoedema (conservative management focused on comfort, mobility and quality of life): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/lipoedema/
- Breast cancer post-operative rehabilitation (shoulder movement, scar, cording and swelling): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/breast-cancer-rehabilitation/
- Chronic venous insufficiency, CVI (compression, calf-pump exercise and skin care alongside medical care): https://www.gojiphysio.com/conditions/chronic-venous-insufficiency/
